judge.rationale: The candidate fails a core acceptance criterion: it wraps non-Error rejections with `new Error(toErrorMessage(error))` without passing `{cause: error}`, even though the issue explicitly requires preserving the original value on `cause` and the candidate's own CHANGELOG falsely claims it did so. Additionally, the candidate fails to test `undefined` rejections as required by the second acceptance criterion. The candidate also leaves behind an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact and creates two redundant test files (`errorWrapping.test.ts` and `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`) in addition to editing `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally,Because it added lines to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` without updating line number references in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, any spec-link validation in the repository would drift compared to the reference.
